documents.unit: Academic Honor Code (Academic Catalog, Office of the Provost)
documents.title: The Academic Honor Code
documents.quality_note: AI appears in the cheating definition and in section III.H (AI use that violates instructor or university guidelines is prohibited); the rest is general honor-code text.

notes: The university-level AI guidance the Honor Code points to (porches.udayton.edu/group/udit/ai/policies-and-guidelines) requires UD login and could not be fetched; the public UDit AI page (udayton.edu/udit/ai) is only a landing page with links. Searches found no School of Engineering, School of Computing or CS department AI policy. Law-program and VLCFF AI rules exist but are not computing.
